The '''CF100 speeder bike''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] available as some point before the [[war against Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CF100 speeder bike appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as a vehicle that can be obtained during '''Chapter 4: The Gravestone'''.
